scope: Controlled single-sequence, single-order-seed full-convolution adaptation pilot; no generalization or training-seed robustness claim
memory_rule: Probe microbatch 2; only if CUDA OOM before training, use microbatch 1 for BOTH trained variants and retain effective batch 16. Record the accepted choice.
checkpoint_rule: Always epoch 6; save epochs 1/3/6, evaluate epoch 6 only. No evaluation-dependent selection.
initialization: Published original GEN1 checkpoint independently loaded for each variant, not previous adapted weights
trainable_full_conv: All feature.* Conv2d weights/biases and head_det_* weights/biases; no encoder/lsnn, no BN affine/statistics, no neuronal rho/threshold changes
loss: Pinned upstream multi-anchor gt_creator and calculate_loss_new with positive normalization; same label geometry as prior adaptation
gradient_accumulation: Weight microbatch loss by max(1,micro_positive_assignments)/max(1,effective_batch_positive_assignments). Empty-positive microbatches still contribute negative-anchor loss; this exactly undoes the pinned criterion denominator.
limitations: One training sequence, one minibatch-order seed
All evaluation sequences have prior development exposure
Equal updates/sample order is not equal training cost
Calibrated evaluation FPPI need not match
This does not reproduce official GEN1 or train a gate
Original sparse execution numerical limitation remains separate
